releaseNotes: OTA v46 pilots Growth Lesson Content Standard v2 for the first three lessons. Lessons now provide 5–7 minute foundational teaching with plain-English definitions, why the skill is difficult, step-by-step mechanics, recognition cues, worked examples that break down why responses work or fail, cross-context transfer examples, key distinctions and quick checks. AI is repositioned from deeper teaching to interactive practice and diagnosis.
